messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] BOOST_NO_CXX11_RVALUE_REFERENCES redefined
parts:
I don't know if there'd be a way to filter that out of the output.

We can't get rid of the message at the source becuase it's coming from
the Boost C++ library, the code for which is out of our control (it's in
the BH package in R and the CRAN maintainers won't let us bundle our own
Boost and Eigen releases due to size concerns). Boost will probably fix
this message and introduce more, which has been the trend over the past
few releases.

- Bob
